name: renovate-ai
description: Redesign a photo of your real room, house or yard in 300+ styles, keeping your layout. Designs are saved to your Renovate AI projects.

interface.longDescription:
Renovate AI shows you what your real home could look like. Share a photo of a room, your house or your yard and Renovate AI redesigns it while keeping your real layout, walls, windows and camera angle, so the result is your space, redesigned.
Try kitchen remodels, bathroom refreshes, living room and bedroom makeovers, new cabinets, floors, paint and furniture. Outside, explore curb appeal, exterior paint colors, siding, porches, backyards, patios, decks and gardens. Pick from 300+ design styles, from Modern and Japandi to Coastal Farmhouse and Warm Modern, plus seasonal decor like Halloween and Christmas, or just describe what you want to change.
Every design appears with a before/after slider you can drag, and is saved to your Renovate AI projects. Ask for your projects any time to see earlier designs or keep iterating on a room. Open any design in Renovate AI to try real paint colors from Benjamin Moore, Sherwin-Williams and Behr, real tile, stone and wood materials, or change just one thing like the cabinets or the floor.
defaultPrompt: Redesign this kitchen with white oak cabinets and a modern look.
Put this sofa in my living room.

positive.description: Redesign a kitchen from a photo in a named style.
positive.prompt: Redesign this kitchen with white oak cabinets and a modern look.
positive.expected_behavior: The Renovate AI card opens on the photo with a loading state, then shows the redesigned kitchen with a draggable before/after slider. ChatGPT replies in one or two sentences with an inline link to open the project in Renovate AI and offers to favorite it.

positive.description: Use a second image as a reference (a sofa) in the user's room.
positive.prompt: Put this sofa in my living room.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT passes the living room as the photo and the sofa as a reference image. The card shows the living room with the caramel leather sofa, keeping the room's walls, windows and camera angle.

positive.description: Show the user's Renovate AI projects.
positive.expected_behavior: The card shows the demo account's projects (Kitchen, Living room, Backyard) with cover images and design counts.

positive.description: Find a project by name and open it.
positive.expected_behavior: The card opens the Backyard project with its original photo, every design, the style and palette of the selected design, and a before/after slider.
After a design from test case 1, ChatGPT favorites the latest design and replies with an inline link to the user's favorites in Renovate AI.

negative.description: Floor plans are out of scope.
negative.prompt: Draw me a floor plan for a three-bedroom house.

negative.description: Not a photo of a room, house or yard.
negative.prompt: Make my dog look like a lion.

negative.description: Cost quotes are out of scope.
negative.prompt: How much does a kitchen remodel cost?

review.commerce_description: Renovate AI does not sell anything in ChatGPT. Designs use the user's existing Renovate AI account; there are no prices, plans, upgrades or checkout links in the plugin.

publication.release_notes: First release. Redesign a photo of your room, house or yard in 300+ styles, use your own reference images, see the result with a before/after slider, and open, rename and favorite your Renovate AI projects.
